name: 単語学習の統計と現在の位置
prompt: Redesign the existing Lighthouse Japanese learning-statistics screen as a clean portrait mobile screen matching the native 390×760 preview. The native preview is authoritative for every Japanese label, numeric value, layout, card size, graph labels and button position. Keep the original screen only as secondary reference for card hierarchy and graph placement; do not copy its beige/tan background, mint icon fills, tinted chart area, English labels or Mobbin footer. Use the attached user example only as palette preference: pure white surfaces, neutral gray inactive states/outlines, and solid green active states; do not copy its circle/check/play geometry or numbers. Make the entire canvas and every card white. Replace the four pale mint metric tiles with separate white tiles and light neutral gray outlines (#E5E7EB). Keep the top score card and streak card as white cards with thin neutral-gray borders. Use flat forest green (#1F6444) for the current 2日 streak, the two completed weekday dots, the user marker/curve, and the primary button; use neutral gray for future weekday dots, graph axes and secondary text. Keep the graph area white with a single green curve and no area fill. Preserve exact Japanese content: ことばの学習記録; 16／30; テストの得点（2026年3月25日）; 連続学習; 2日; 火 水 木 金 土 日 月; 128 読んだ語; 4 お気に入り; 7 保存した語; 10 練習した回数; 学習者の4%より上にいます; あなたのスコア：29; あなた; 0; 平均; 100; 今すぐ練習する. Preserve the exact 2×2 metric ordering and chart/button relationship. Use Meiryo-compatible Japanese type, clear contrast, thin borders, compact spacing and no decorative icons. Flat colors only: no mint/cyan/tan/orange/pink fills, pastel tints, gradients, shadows, glows, textures, or translucent overlays. Do not add iOS status bar or extra text.
reviewNotes: Replaced tinted metric tiles with white surfaces and neutral gray outlines; chart is unfilled; active streak/action use solid green. Pending owner review.
